arabic text: KATLE SHABIR HUWE CHIN GAYI ZAINAB KI RIDA\nLUT GAYE AALE ABAA
english translation text: SHABBIR HAS BEEN MURDERED, ZAINAB’S HIJAB HAS BEEN SNATCHED\nAHL-E-BAIT HAVE BEEN LOOTED,

arabic text: AAJ ATHARA BANI FATEMA KA KHUNN BAHA\nLUT GAYE AALE ABAA.
english translation text: THE BLOOD OF EIGHTEEN SONS OF FATEMA FLOWED TODAY\nAHL-E-BAIT HAVE BEEN LOOTED,

arabic text: NEHR PAR BAZUE SAKAAYE HARAM KAATE GAYE\nDUKH BARE NANA SAHE
english translation text: THE ARMS OF THE ONE WHO QUENCHES THE AHL-E-BAIT’S THIRST HAVE BEEN SEVERED\nOUR GRANDFATHER BEARS IMMENSE PAIN

arabic text: BAAZUE SIBTE NABI SHEHRE DILAAWAR NA RAHA
english translation text: THE ARMS OF THE FRIEND AND BRAVE LION OF THE PROPHET HAVE GONE

arabic text: LUT GAYI HAZRATE ZAINAB KI KAMAI RANME\nGUL HUWE AADAME MAI\nDAAG SAIDANIYOKO AKBARE NAUSHAA KAMILA
english translation text: LADY ZAINAB’S LIFE’S EFFORTS WERE LOOTED, LOST WAS\nTHE FLOWER (SHE RAISED) THE PAIN OF AKBAR\nWAS INFLICTED ON THE LADIES OF AHLE-BAIT

arabic text: LASHE ASGHAR KOLIYE DEWRIPE BAHALE TABAA\nSHAANE DI YE SAADA\nNANE MASUM KI GARDAN PE LAGA TEER JAFA
english translation text: IN A STATE OF DISTRESS,\nCARRYING THE BODY OF ASGHAR,\nIMAM CRIED OUT MY INNOCENT INFANT’S NECK HAS BEEN PIERCED BY A TYRANT’S ARROW

arabic text: SAR KHULE UNTHOPE SAIDAANIYA SAB SATH GAYI\nRAAHIYE SHAAM HUWI\nKOI PURSA NA MADAD GHAAR NA UNKA HII RAHA
english translation text: WITH BARE HEADS ALL LADIES OF AHL-E-BAIT ARE BEING\nTAKEN ON CAMELS ON THEIR WAY TO SHAM, THERE\nIS NO ONE LEFT TO CONSOLE OR HELP THEM

arabic text:
DAAG LE KAR MAI BAHAT-TAR KA SUUE SHAAM GAYI
THI AJAB DARBADARI
BERIYA PEHNE HUWE AABIDE BIMAR CHALAA
LUT GAYE AALE ABAA.
english translation text:
ABID-E-BIMAR WALKED BOUND IN CHAINS
GOING TOWARDS SHAM CARRYING THE
PAIN OF SEVENTY TWO (MARTYRS)
MY DISPLACEMENT FELT VERY STRANGE

arabic text: HIND NE AAKE YE SAJJAD SE ZINNDA MAI KAHA\nDIJIYE TAABIR BATA\nKHOON ME DUBA HUWA MAINE JO QURAN DEKHA
english translation text: HIND ASKED SAJJAD IN THE DUNGEON\nEXPLAIN TO ME THE MEANING OF\nSEEING THE QUR’AN DRENCHED IN BLOOD
